instruction: tomli takes quadratic time on a key with a pathological number of dotted parts (a.a.a. ... = 1 with tens of thousands of parts). Limit the number of parts in one key to sys.getrecursionlimit(), as nesting of inline arrays and tables is already limited: tomli.loads must raise RecursionError with a message matching 'TOML key has more than the allowed N parts' (N the limit) for a key with more parts than that, in a key/value pair or a table header, while keys with up to the limit (310 parts, or getrecursionlimit() - 1 parts) still parse normally.
